//: The app's half of the estate provenance contract. This repo has no page bytes to sign: the worker composes the shell per request, so what is signed is the BUILD. `python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/attest_page.py --build` runs scripts/attest-build.sh (npm run build + wrangler deploy --dry-run, then a sorted inventory of both halves), signs that, and rewrites the constant the worker serves at /jam/index.json. `--build --check` recomputes it inside check.sh; `--build --deployed` runs after deploy.sh moves traffic.
digest_scope: the worker bundle wrangler deploy --dry-run builds from this commit plus a sorted sha256 inventory of every file `npm run build` emits, taken with the build manifest emptied
